title: Browse a real run with at least 100 artifacts
description: Use an explicit authenticated gateway profile and an unobstructed desktop-width owned tab already showing FARMSLOT_ARTIFACT_PROOF_RUN_ID. Set FARMSLOT_ARTIFACT_PROOF_TAB and FARMSLOT_ARTIFACT_PROOF_OUTPUT. The real retained inventory must contain at least 100 files, folder groups, an image and Markdown. Uses actual controls, reads and previews; no run/slot changes or UI state injection.

browse-artifacts.intent: Read the actual run and match all displayed paths. Start with a real collapsed folder, expand matching groups through their controls, filter by type, search, collapse and expand a folder, decode an image preview and render Markdown in the existing browser.
